description: Book a HomeMaster service for the customer: only the one they asked for, never an extra. Ask for their name, their phone number and their OK first, and never fill a field with a guess or a placeholder. The answer's `outcome` says what was booked. (1) whatsapp_card, home cleaning: we sent the customer Helen's booking card on WhatsApp, showing the date, their address, the clean and their price; nothing is booked until they tap "Yes, book it" within 60 minutes, then they pay by the payment link Helen sends, and the time is not held while they decide. Needs postal_code, unit, date with its weekday, a start_time from find_times, and the hours the customer chose. Returns a reference for booking_status. (2) call_back_booked, a service under more_services: HomeMaster needs to find out more before it can price and schedule the job, so what you book is a call back, free of charge. Tell the customer that, ask when they are free for a call, and send a 2-hour window (call_back_date, its call_back_weekday, and call_back_from). Our team calls them in that window with the price and a time for the job. No message is sent and nothing is paid. Returns a reference (hmc_) for booking_status. To move the call, call this again with a new window. For a customer with several such jobs, book each service in the same window: our team makes one call. After booking, read back to the customer the day and the number in the answer (booked_for, or sent_to for a clean): if either is not what they said, book again with the right one. HomeMaster has no emergency service: for someone who needs help now, say so, and offer the call back only as a follow-up. A refusal means nothing is booked. (3) pick_a_call_back_time: you called for such a service without a window; nothing is saved, and the answer holds the question to ask and the windows we take. Aircon servicing is not booked here: use start_booking.

agent_name.description: Optional, cleaning: your name as the customer knows you (letters, digits and spaces), shown on the card as "<name> asked us to book this for you".

call_back_date.description: A service under more_services: the day the customer is free for our call, YYYY-MM-DD, Singapore date, today to 14 days ahead.

call_back_from.description: A service under more_services: the start of the 2-hour window for our call, HH:MM in Singapore time, on the hour or half hour, 09:00 to 19:00 (so the latest window is 7pm to 9pm).

call_back_weekday.description: A service under more_services: the weekday the customer agreed to for the call, e.g. Saturday. Required with call_back_date; we refuse a date that is not that weekday.

customer_confirmed.description: Required. true only when the customer themselves gave you every detail you are sending (their number, the unit, the day, the hours or the job) and said yes to this booking. If you filled in or guessed any of it, do not send: ask them first.

customer_name.description: The customer's name. Required for a service under more_services. For cleaning: recommended, saved only once they confirm, and never over a name we already have.

details.description: A service under more_services: the job in the customer's words, with what the price depends on (see its service card): what, how many, what size, what is wrong. Never make a detail up.

frequency.description: Cleaning only: one-time, weekly, or bi-weekly (every 2 weeks).

hours.description: Cleaning only: visit length in hours (see find_services for the lengths we sell, e.g. 2, 3 or 4).

phone.description: The customer's 8-digit Singapore number, exactly as they gave it, e.g. 9123 4567. We add +65 ourselves: do not add, repeat or drop a digit. For cleaning it must be on WhatsApp.

preferred_job_time.description: A service under more_services, optional: when the customer would like the JOB done, in their words (e.g. Saturday mornings, within two weeks). The call-back window is only for the call.

service.description: Required: the service the customer asked for, from find_services. cleaning (general housekeeping only), or the code of a service under more_services, e.g. pipe_leak_repair.

start_time.description: Cleaning: HH:MM in Singapore time, one of the start times from find_times.

unit.description: Cleaning: floor AND unit number, e.g. #05-12 (for a landed house, the house number). The floor alone is not a unit number. Ask the customer; never make one up.

weekday.description: Cleaning: the weekday the customer agreed to, e.g. Saturday. Required with date; we refuse a date that is not that weekday.

title: Book for the customer
